# Instilligent Limited

> New Zealand software company building practical software for regulated industries. Products: Modular Compliance and BossBoard, plus Instilligent Courses and others.

## About

Instilligent is a New Zealand-based software company founded in 2015 by Marc Armstrong. We build practical software for regulated industries in New Zealand: a compliance register and workflow tool (Modular Compliance), invoicing and job records for tradies (BossBoard), and related products.

## Products

- [Modular Compliance](https://modularcompliance.com) — Live. NZ-built compliance register and workflow tool. Maps legislation into frameworks, controls and tasks, records who completed what and when, and stores supporting evidence — people do the compliance work, the tool keeps the record. Starter NZ$199/month + GST, Professional NZ$499/month + GST, Enterprise by enquiry. Register at https://app.modularcompliance.com/register.
- [BossBoard](https://bossboard.instilligent.com) — Invoicing, quotes and job records for NZ tradies, with 15% GST built in. Works on mobile and desktop.
- [Mastering MOSS](https://masteringmoss.co.nz) — Maritime Operator Safety System (MOSS) for NZ commercial maritime operators. From NZD 29/month. Live.
- [Instilligent Courses](https://courses.instilligent.com) — AI practice exams and structured courses for NZ professionals.
- [CodeHumanist](https://codehumanist.com) — Read-only codebase comprehension platform for human stakeholders. Understand AI-generated codebases — architecture, data flows, use cases — without touching code. Currently waitlist.
- [ProofOnce](https://proofonce.com) — Planned document and identity verification product. Verify once, reuse across consumers. Coming Soon / pre-launch.
